definitions: To surrender or yield, especially weapons or authority.
To establish or set forth as a rule, principle, or law.
To sacrifice one's life for something or someone.
To store something for future use, especially wine or provisions.
To put something down gently or carefully.
examples: The soldiers were ordered to lay down their arms.
The committee will lay down new guidelines for employee conduct.
He was willing to lay down his life for his country.
They decided to lay down a few cases of wine for the special occasion.
She carefully laid down the baby in the crib.
